(i) there has to be cruelty inflicted against the victim which either drives her to commit suicide or cause grave injury to herself or to lead such conduct that would cause grave injury and danger to life, limb or health, or (ii) harassment with a view to satisfy an unlawful demand for any property or valuable security. 86.
